title: The Peacock and Juno
summary: A peacock complained bitterly to the heavens that while his plumage was gorgeous, the nightingale was gifted with a voice of divine melody....
full_text:
A peacock complained bitterly to the heavens that while his plumage was gorgeous, the nightingale was gifted with a voice of divine melody.

The celestial queen replied: "To you is given dazzling beauty and feathers of emerald and gold; to the eagle, strength; to the nightingale, melody; and to the falcon, speed. Be content with your own magnificent gift instead of coveting what belongs to another!"
moral: Every creature has its appointed gift; envy of another’s talent poisons present joy.
